mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood and then recovering useful substances made the kidney’s job clear: small substances initially enter the tubule, and needed materials are returned to blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was straightforward, but those two steps offered less to figure out than the filtering sequence.

surprise.text: The distinction between filtration and recovery stood out: useful glucose passes into the tubule before almost all of it is normally recovered.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and results gave each connection a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the progression from blood filtration to recovery and then connection to the body made me curious how another system would fit into the larger model.
